The appellant is sentence to undergo R.I. for 10 years and fine of Rs. 15,000/- u/s 4 of the POCSO Act read with section 376 of the I.P.C. as per provision of section 42 of POCSO Act and in default of payment of fine he will sentence to undergo S.I. for six months.

sentences.text:
3. Earlier, the matter stands admitted on 12.12.2024 by a coordinate Bench and the Trial Court report was called for which has now been received and the written objection is also on record.
4.
Learned counsel for the appellant prays for bail submitting that he is in custody since 25.03.2022.
5. Learned APP on the other hand opposed the prayer submitting that the conviction is of ten years rigorous imprisonment and he has not even completed three years of it.
He has further taken this Court to the conviction order to show that beside 376 of the Indian Penal Code, he has also found guilty under section 4 of the POCSO Act.

6. Considering the submissions put forward by the parties as also the fact that the appellant stands convicted and Patna High Court CR. APP (SJ) No.5597 of 2023(8) dt.10-02-2025 the sentence is of ten years rigorous imprisonment under section 376 of the Indian Penal Code as rightly pointed out by the learned APP, he has not completed even three years of the sentence, for the present, this Court is not inclined to extend him the privilege of bail.
7. Accordingly, the prayer for bail stands rejected.

(Rajiv Roy, J) vinayak/-
